Start date: 1348-01-08  
Subtract 28 weeks = 28 × 7 = 196 days.  
Subtract 6 more days → total subtract 202 days.  

1348 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-Gregorian but using Gregorian rules as instructed).  
Jan 8 minus 202 days:  
Go back to 1347:  
Jan 8 → back 8 days = 1347-12-31.  
Remaining 194 days back from 1347-12-31:  
Dec 31 back 31 days = Nov 30.  
Remaining 163 days:  
November has 30 days → back 30 more = Oct 31 (remaining 133).  
October has 31 → back 31 = Sep 30 (remaining 102).  
September has 30 → back 30 = Aug 31 (remaining 72).  
August has 31 → back 31 = Jul 31 (remaining 41).  
July has 31 → back 31 = Jun 30 (remaining 10).  
June has 30 → back 10 days = Jun 20, 1347.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1347-06-20
